info.name: Resource Usage Management
info.description: TMF771 Resource Usage Management provides a standaised mechanism for usage management such as creation, update, retrieval, import and export of a collection of resource usage. A Resource usage represents is an occurrence of usage on a Resource, which can be further used to generate interest to a billing system, and can have charges applied to it. It is comprised of characteristics which define all attributes known for a particular type of Resource usage.
